hebrewText: אִ֣ישׁ אֱ֭מוּנוֹת רַב בְּרָכ֑וֹת וְ/אָ֥ץ לְ֝/הַעֲשִׁ֗יר לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).

tokens.bdb: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.kjv: faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.enLiteralWord: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.explanation: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
tokens.explanationEn: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity

tokens.bdb: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
tokens.kjv: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).

tokens.bdb: to press; (by implication) to be close, hurry, withdraw
properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich
tokens.kjv: be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See H6240 (עָשָׂר).

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.

tokens.bdb: to be (or make) clean (literally or figuratively); by implication (in an adverse sense) to be bare, i.e. extirpated
tokens.kjv: acquit [idiom] at all, [idiom] altogether, be blameless, cleanse, (be) clear(-ing), cut off, be desolate, be free, be (hold) guiltless, be (hold) innocent, [idiom] by no means, be quit, be (leave) unpunished, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] wholly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be  clean ; by implication  to be bare
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be  clean ; by implication  to be bare
tokens.explanation: to be  clean ; by implication  to be bare
tokens.explanationEn: to be  clean ; by implication  to be bare
